sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VII, Sec. 703 — Ventilation Standards
sources.description: Sets minimum ventilation requirements by occupancy: natural ventilation (10% of floor area for openings) and mechanical ventilation standards.

sources.label: ASHRAE Standard 62.1 — Ventilation for Acceptable Indoor Air Quality
sources.description: International standard referenced in Philippine practice for minimum ventilation rates based on occupancy type and floor area.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VII — Light and Ventilation Requirements for Habitable Rooms
sources.description: Specifies minimum window area (10% of floor area) and mechanical ventilation requirements for rooms without natural ventilation.
